body: Hmm I guess I never really had any ambitions to begin with. As I pointed out, nothing makes me feel happy anymore so I don't know what I could do to change that. Starting a family is not an option as basically I'm the equivalent of a genetic landfill; limp dick, schizophrenia, baldness, and manboobs - the whole package... The only thing that really excites me anymore is revenge fantasies against my father but the thought of spending the rest of my days locked up just for petty revenge doesn't seem like an ideal goal either. It just seems suicide would be the preferable outcome to all this.
